_about: Travelovegas listings inventory, rebuilt from the old Wix site screenshots and re-checked Oct 8, 2026. status: open = recent evidence it's operating; likely_open = evergreen, no closure news found, confirm on the affiliate page before linking; changed = still exists but key facts moved; seasonal = open part of the year; temp_closed; closed = remove. Old prices and hours from the Wix site are NOT carried over; every price/hours field starts null until verified.

listings.name: Fountains of Bellagio
listings.alert: Sidewalk in front of the fountains is closed until Nov 9 for F1 construction.
listings.notes: Patriotic fountain show ran June 29 to July 4, 2026. Sidewalk in front of the fountains closed Sept 14 to Nov 9, 2026 for F1 Fountain Club construction; viewing is limited during F1 build-out. Show times only from third-party guides, not listed. Free per Visit Las Vegas: "costs absolutely nothing to enjoy."

listings.name: Bellagio Conservatory & Botanical Gardens
listings.notes: New autumn display unveiled Sept 23, 2026 (described as a "nostalgic autumn escape"); official display name and end date not stated. Free to visit. Visit Las Vegas: "a free attraction you can return to again and again."

listings.name: Eiffel Tower Viewing Deck
listings.notes: Deck tickets were part of the Las Vegas 5-Day Sale (Sept 22, 2026). Official page live. Old 'from $27.01' price dropped; re-price from affiliate.

listings.name: The STRAT SkyPod & Thrill Rides
listings.notes: OLD COPY WAS WRONG: described a fire-and-water show near the Mirage, not the STRAT. Rewrite from scratch. Official attractions page lists SkyPod, thrill rides (incl. Big Shot) and SkyJump; X-Scream and Insanity not named there, so do not mention them.

listings.name: SkyJump

listings.notes: Limited residency. 2026 dates: Oct 1, 3, 8, 10, 15, 17, 22, 24, 29, 31; Nov 5, 7. 2027: Jan 28, 30; Feb 4, 6, 18, 20, 25, 27; Mar 4, 6, 11, 13. Different setlist Thu vs Sat. Sold via Ticketmaster, reported sold out; no affiliate link. Mark closed after Mar 13, 2027.

listings.name: Grand Canyon West & Skywalk

listings.name: Grand Celebration Helicopter Tour (Papillon)
listings.notes: Official site: Grand Canyon West with canyon floor landing, about 4 to 4.5 hours hotel to hotel. Also Golden Eagle Air Tour (about 3.5 to 4 hours). Prices not on the overview page. Most tours run 364 days a year. link via Viator search index

listings.name: Las Vegas Strip Helicopter Night Flight
listings.venue: Maverick Helicopters, 6075 S Las Vegas Blvd

listings.name: Hoover Dam Tours
listings.price: Guided Dam Tour: $40 per person; Guided Power Plant Tour: Adults $25, ages 4-16 $15; Self-Guided Visitor Center Tour: $15 per person; children 3 and under free
listings.hours: Visitor Center and tours daily 9am-5pm, last tour 4:10pm; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas
listings.notes: Official Bureau of Reclamation page (updated July 29, 2026). Guided Dam Tour tickets sold on site only, first come first served. Interagency passes not accepted. Tours may be cancelled without notice. link via Viator search index

listings.name: Red Rock Canyon Scenic Drive

listings.hours: Scenic Drive 6am-7pm in October; 6am-5pm Nov-Feb; 6am-7pm March; 6am-8pm Apr-Sept
listings.notes: Timed-entry reservation required Oct 1 to May 31 for entry 8am-5pm (Recreation.gov). Entry fee amount not stated on BLM page; leave null. Red Rock Overlook is free with no reservation. Commercial tour buses limited to 4 stops, no hiking. link via Viator search index

listings.name: Valley of Fire State Park
listings.venue: Overton, NV (about 1 hour from the Strip)

listings.name: Grand Canyon South Rim Day Tour
listings.notes: NPS conditions page (updated Sept 1, 2026). Long day trip from Vegas (South Rim is far; pick an operator on the affiliate). Entrance fee not stated on the page. link via Viator search index

listings.name: Zion National Park Day Tour
listings.notes: NPS page (updated Sept 16, 2026). East Rim Trail partly closed after rockfall; Hidden Canyon closed; Observation Point only from the east. Free shuttles run early spring to late fall. link via Viator search index

listings.name: Death Valley Day Tour
listings.notes: NPS page (updated Oct 2, 2026). Scotty's Castle and Bonnie Clare Road closed, no reopening date. Titus Canyon one-way section closed until about May 2027; two-way section closed Oct 27 through December 2026. Darwin Falls road closed until about summer 2027. link via Viator search index

listings.name: The Neon Museum

Near Jean Dry Lake and I-15, about ten miles south of Las Vegas. BLM lease reported to end Dec 2026 (KTNV); official site says an extension plan is in the works. Show a banner.

listings.name: Flamingo Wildlife Habitat
